title: Functional assays with human patient-derived enteroid monolayers to assess the human gut barrier
author: Sayed, Tindle, et al.

steps.title: Preserve biopsies in ice-cold wash media
steps.instruction: Transfer freshly collected colonic or ileal biopsies into wash media containing ROCK inhibitors and keep on ice until processing.

steps.title: Digest tissue with collagenase and gentamicin
steps.instruction: Cut tissues into 2 mm pieces and incubate with 1–2 mL collagenase type I (2 mg/mL) plus gentamicin (50 µg/mL) in PBS at 37 °C, checking every 10–15 min and pipetting mechanically; stop when 50–80 % of tissue is digested (≈30–40 min).

steps.title: Inactivate collagenase with wash media
steps.instruction: Add at least an equal volume of wash media containing fetal bovine serum to the digestion mixture to neutralize collagenase activity.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension through 70‑µm strainer
steps.instruction: Pass the digested mixture through a 70‑µm cell strainer to collect single cells or small clusters and remove debris.

steps.title: Wash and centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Wash the filtered cells with wash media, then centrifuge the cell pellet at 200 × g for 5 min.

steps.title: Embed cells in Matrigel and culture with WRN media
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in Matrigel domes and culture in 50 % stem‑cell‑enriched WRN conditioned media (WNT3a, R‑spondin, Noggin) supplemented with Y‑27632 (ROCKi), SB‑431542, nicotinamide, A‑83‑01, EGF, and SB‑202190 at the concentrations listed in the Materials table; media are obtained from HUMANOID CoRE.

steps.title: Prepare primary culture medium (100 mL)
steps.instruction: Mix Advanced DMEM/F‑12 (to 100 mL), add fetal bovine serum to a final 20 % (20 mL), and add Glutamax 100× to a final 2 mM (2 mL). Adjust volume to 100 mL.

steps.title: Prepare human monolayer EDMs medium (100 mL)
steps.instruction: Combine 90 mL of the primary culture medium with 5 mL of 50 % WRN conditioned media (no inhibitors), add Y‑27632 to a final 10 µM (10 µL of 10 mM stock), and add N‑acetyl‑cysteine to a final 1 mM (100 µL of 500 mM stock); bring volume to 100 mL with sterile water.

steps.title: Prepare organoid cocktail medium (50 mL)
steps.instruction: To 49 mL of base medium add the following: Y‑27632 10 µM (50 µL of 10 mM), SB‑431542 10 µM (50 µL of 10 mM), Glutamax 1 mM (250 µL of 200 mM), NAC 1 mM (100 µL of 500 mM), rh‑EGF 100 ng/mL (25 µL of 100 µg/mL), Nicotinamide 500 µM (500 µL of 1 M), A‑83‑01 12.5 µM (12.5 µL of 0.5 mM), SB‑202190 10 µM (17 µL of 30 mM). Aliquot components and store at –80 °C; avoid repeated freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Make stock solutions for supplements
steps.instruction: Prepare the following stocks: NAC 500 mM – dissolve 1.64 g in 20 mL water, filter (0.2 µm) and aliquot; Nicotinamide 1 M – dissolve 2.44 g in 20 mL water, filter and aliquot; Y‑27632 10 mM – dissolve per manufacturer’s instructions (Tocris); SB‑202190 30 mM – add 2.51 mL DMSO to a 25 mg vial, aliquot 20 µL; SB‑431542 10 mM – dissolve per manufacturer’s instructions (Tocris); A‑83‑01 2 mM – dissolve per manufacturer’s instructions (Tocris). Store all aliquots at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare washing media (500 mL)
steps.instruction: Combine Advanced DMEM/F‑12 (to 500 mL), add fetal bovine serum to 10 % (50 mL), add Glutamax 100× to 2 mM (5 mL), and add Penicillin/Streptomycin 1× (5 mL). Note: for infection experiments omit antibiotics.

steps.title: Generate e‑cigarette vapor‑infused infection media
steps.instruction: Use e‑liquid composed of 70 % propylene glycol and 30 % glycerol, optionally containing 6 mg/mL nicotine. Activate the e‑cigarette battery, apply negative pressure to draw and vaporize the liquid, and pass the vapor into a syringe containing 10 mL DMEM/F‑12 with 15 mM HEPES and 10 % FBS. Expose this mixture to 50 mL of generated vapor for 30 cycles, allowing a 12‑second interval between each exposure, to produce the infection media.

steps.title: Prepare LB broth stock (1 L)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 20 g LB broth (10 g tryptone, 5 g yeast extract, 5 g NaCl) in 1 L distilled water (20 g L⁻¹). Autoclave at 121 °C for 20 min, cool to 20–22 °C, aliquot into 50 mL tubes, and store at 4 °C (2 weeks–1 month).

steps.title: Prepare LB agar plates for bacterial assay
steps.instruction: Mix 25 g LB broth and 15 g agar (1.5 % w/v) in 1 L distilled water. Autoclave at 121 °C for 20 min, cool until warm but not solidified, then pour 6 mL per tri‑section of a tri‑plate. Allow agar to solidify at 20–22 °C, store plates sealed at 4 °C (2–4 weeks). Before use, equilibrate plates at room temperature (20–22 °C) for 10–15 min.

description: Biopsies from healthy humans should be processed shortly after the sample collection. Biopsies should be preserved and transferred in wash media containing ROCK inhibitors on ice package. Crypt-derived stem cells were isolated from the colonic and ileal biopsies of healthy human subjects, grown as 3D organoids (Jung et al., 2011, Sato et al., 2011, Sato et al., 2009, Ghosh et al., 2020, Sayed et al., 2020a, Sayed et al., 2020c, Sharma et al., 2021).CRITICAL: It is recommended to isolate the stem cells from the biopsies at the same day of collection. Isolation of the stem cells was also successful if it is done within 48 h of samples collection as long as the biopsies are preserved in the same condition of sample collection (i.e same transport media and ice package).
